items.note: K.1 states the three-stage signed exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with scratch restoration, and K.1.1-K.1.3 follow the proof at 741-765 (net change (JV+RG)x, cancellation of intersection-one coefficients, three stages). The plan never fixes h=100, N, m, the indexing by triples or the neighbour rule, and it argues the coefficient cancellation only for the bit case, leaving out the complex case (756-758).

It states the frame invariant, the commutation of a common frame with a pointwise linear gate, the operator D_out S D_in^{-1}, and the route operator eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1} on all roles, all as at 804-825.

Statement correct: nested nondegenerate labels in the m-dimensional F^{(x)3}, only the central 3->4 edges decrease (by h each), L=Ich, the budget Wm-2N+2L, and the ratios 100/539 and 101/539. The derivation names the route (triple indicators, tensoring, a residual table) but gives neither the bilinear forms (I-J/9 over Q, dot product over F_2) nor the gate labels and residual table, and it omits the orthonormal-basis argument over F_2.

It has projections on nested labels with rank equal to the dimension change, the N negative source projections adding one rank each, s=Wm-N+2L with deficit N-2L>0, and the endpoint identity P_{U_a^perp}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m. Applied through shear frames, these give H<-H+D on every role (K.7), following 1156-1171.

It defines the phase frames C_U and states one kernel aI+bX_v (or its inverse) per orthonormal residual vector and s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c<W_c m. The claim that telescoping gives C^{(x)m} on every role omits the source/sink diagonal (Z, i^{27}) corrections and the undoing of the signed exchange that the paper needs (1225-1227, 1297-1314). Weight additivity mod 4, the core of the proof, is absent, so I do not credit a derivation.

The chain L/N<1/2 -> deficit N-2L>0 -> s<Wm -> relative deficit above 20*2^{-50} -> s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50} is present and follows the paper. The exact deficits eta_b, eta_c and the fact log m<20 are not given; they appear only implicitly through the quoted inequality.

Both lemmas are stated with their O(V) bounds. The condition that the offset be prepared in b^{O(1)} time appears in S1.2's quote, not its claim. S1.2's 'splitting blocks and re-merging' only hints at the proof.

It gives the lower-triangular factorization E_1 Pi E_2 by the paper's pivot elimination and the shear with exactly a interchanges: triangular transforms at O(V), then one interchange per one of Pi via D_j<-D_j+H_i, swap, D_j<-H_i-D_j. The choice of the prime q is not mentioned, which is not essential.

It has the row split into W role streams of volume V/W, shear frames with recursive interchanges per edge rank, H<-H+D on every row, the three-update interchange, s calls, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), the geometric sum giving O(e^tau), and the fixed-tape parking stack, as at 1491-1588.

It covers the high digits as rows, padding to a multiple of W^k, base-m pieces at cost O(V) sum a_j m^{j tau}=O(Ve^tau), and binary padding to [q^e]. It omits joining h^+ next to d^+ so that the row field precedes both remaining chunks, and the final separation (1662-1676, 1709-1712). I chose partial conservatively.

It states s_c child calls on f=e/m axes and H_0^{(x)D}=b^D S_D C^{(x)D} S_D. The binary change of basis P_M is only alluded to ('binary basis changes'), without the conjugation that puts residual directions on coordinate slots (1849-1862). The inverse-child identity (C^{-1})^{(x)f}=(-i)^f Z C Z that keeps every child forward is absent.

It has eight packed conditional additions restoring z, the bad set of fraction at most 80(f-1)2^{-K} from guard intervals, each rotation as a chunk swap plus an O(V) controlled shift, extraction and radix-sort repair implementing T_0, and the o(1) extra terms, all as in the proof.

Correct: s calls, node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)), children of volume V/W, F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1), leaves O(e), and the base-m sum to O(d^{lambda'}). The plan does not say the rows come from the first q_0 chunks (2306-2323). It also skips the unrolling, where K<=e^{c/beta} gives O(e^lambda) overhead and the leaves give e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)} (2413-2430).

It gives the layer at O(Vd^{lambda'}), the depth recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, denominator and modulus growth, guard bits Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1})=o(p), one final truncation with error < sqrt2 2^{-p}, and the row-sum-one disk argument, following the paper.

It covers roots omega_t=y^{2r/t}, character cancellation, decimation in frequency, bit-reversed storage giving B_t F_t^- and F_t^+ B_t^{-1}, prefix moves O(TpdK), chunk exchanges O(Tp pK^{tau-1}), layer rounds O(Tp l d^{lambda'}), and error < sqrt2 l 2^{-p}, matching the paper.

Evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, the coefficient bound |h_j|<B_0/2, centred-residue recovery with carries, the numerator streams ac-be and ae+bc, and negacyclic reduction are all present, at cost O(rp log(rp)).

It has two forward transforms kept in their common LB order (with the motivation that pointwise products commute with a common record permutation), signed-packing products, the opposite transform, scaling by M=T/r, error < sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^{-p}, and the extra O(Tp log(rp)) cost.

Statement correct, including the identity, the error p^2, the cost, the tensor form with gamma=2d alpha^2, and line exposure. The derivation keeps the Neumann inversion and the choice A=S', B_0=D'J'C. It leaves out the Gaussian maps S, T and the HvdH identity T P_s F_s=P_t F_t S, from which B_0 is obtained as a left inverse, and the algorithms achieving error < p^2 in O(t p^{3/2+delta} alpha).

It has the chirp identity checked coefficientwise, RF^+R=F^+ because t_i is a unit mod s_i, and the convolution normalizations giving (u*v)/S^2, as in the proof. Conjugation for RF^+ is only implicit.

All fixed exponents, the sizes, the prime-interval argument, T/2<S<T, alpha^4 theta_i>p and the n^{o(1)} search are given along the paper's route. The value eta=1/(4d) and the definition of alpha are never stated, though the latter is implicit in the S6.1.1.4 quote.
It has the isomorphism Phi, the triangular digit formula, the update order i=d..1, prefix-controlled cyclic shifts, and axis reversal by chunk exchanges at O(Tp d^2(1+l^tau)), all as in the paper.

The exact twist isomorphism and the wrap check (4308-4318) are derived, and S6.5 gives the computed procedure. The formula M_C=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g)=(f*g)/T is not written, and the twist error bound (<4*2^{-p} each) and its derivation at 4349-4413 are absent.

The source transform (A~, chirp transform, B~_0, 2^gamma), the six steps, and the exact counterpart (u*v)/S^2 -> (u*v)/S -> 2^{2b+4}(u*v) follow the paper. Two things are missing: the digits scaled by 2^{-b-2}, and the definition of F~^+ by conjugation.

From E_s=9*2^gamma TL through E_w<28*2^gamma T^2 L to the final error < 448b 2^{-3b/4} < 1/2, rounding and carries, the chain is correct. The plan starts at E_s without deriving it: the ring-convolution and chirp error steps and disk margins (4557-4650) are skipped, and gamma<=b/4 is only implicit.

It has the cost table, the margins g_1..g_7 with min 2^{-181}=2kappa, each row traced to its procedure, the exceptional sorting at o(V), log p powers absorbed, and the schoolbook cutoff, as in the paper.
S0 says the bound refutes the n log n conjecture in this model, but nothing about the eventual lower bound, its negation via liminf, or the limit zero.

errors.says: Telescoping the phase frames gives C^{(x)m} on every role, scratch roles included.
errors.paper: Telescoping gives C^{(x)m} only after source and sink diagonal corrections and undoing the signed bank exchange. Without them the X_a->Y_a route carries C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a), and the X outputs carry a minus sign.

errors.says: The labels make each edge's orthogonal residual have dimension equal to the number of smaller operations the edge needs.
errors.paper: Edge rank equals the residual dimension except on the N source edges of the X_a roles. There the matrix is 2P_{U_a}, of rank one, while the dimension change is zero, so those edges need one operation each (fixed in K.3.3).

chain: The tree reaches O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}) by the paper's route. The exchange network, frames, labels and rank saving feed the interchange recurrence. The phase network gives the simultaneous layer, then synthetic transforms, ring convolution, resampling with chirp cancellation, CRT assembly, exact recovery and the cost table. The bit-network core is reconstructed carefully. Elsewhere the chain thins out in four places. The network's parameters (h=100, N, m) are never fixed. The complex phase interface and phase-frame recursion lack weight additivity, the P_M change of basis and the inverse-child identity. The layer recurrence omits where its rows come from. The resampling and error chains start from quoted results (the HvdH identity, E_s) rather than derived ones.

steps.note: The fixed linear network on three-element subsets with (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) and scratch restoration is stated. h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 are never given; m appears only as the dimension of F^{(x)3}. With the defining quantities missing, I chose the conservative verdict.

A common invertible frame per gate commutes with the pointwise gate, so the network implements D_out S D_in^{-1}, the route operator depends only on endpoint frames, and intermediate frames are free to make edges cheap.

It has nondegenerate subspaces of the m-dimensional F^{(x)3} built from triple indicators (neighbours orthogonal), comparable labels on every edge, and only the central 3->4 edges decreasing, each by h.
P_V-P_U has rank dim V-dim U, so edge cost equals the dimension change. The N negative source projections are the exceptions, adding one rank each (K.3 method).
It has the sum of |Delta dim| = Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, and s=Wm-N+2L.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539 are below 1/2, so the deficit N-2L>0 and s<Wm.
P_{U_a^perp}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m for X_a, and source 0 / sink I_m on the other roles, so the shear frames give Phi_{I_m}, i.e. H<-H+D, on every role including scratch rows.
A=E_1 Pi E_2 gives exactly a interchanges plus O(V), so the number of recursive calls on an edge is its rational rank and a node makes s calls in all.

It has children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), the relative deficit above 20*2^{-50} giving s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50}, and F_k=O(e^tau). The fact log m<20 is used only implicitly through the quoted inequality.

central.summary: The central saving is reconstructed in full except its starting data. Frames, labels, rank equal to dimension change with the N source exceptions, the budget Wm-N+2L, the ratios 100/539 and 101/539, the endpoint identity, edges as rank-many recursive interchanges, and the recurrence to e^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} all appear in their roles. Only C1 falls short: the network's exchange and restoration are stated, but h=100, N and m are never fixed.
